evals.prompt: Direction C is selected for our responsive React product. Turn it into a durable contract for desktop, narrow browser, and the same web UI packaged through Capacitor on Android. We have plain CSS variables and Playwright but no token compiler or Storybook.
evals.expected_output: Encodes one repository-owned contract and shared web/mobile source map, keeps the established CSS-variable authority rather than adding unnecessary infrastructure, uses existing browser and packaged-app evidence where relevant, and leaves baselines untouched until explicit human acceptance.
expectations: Detects one web UI source plus an additional packaged Android verification target rather than creating a native component system.
Uses existing CSS variables and does not add Style Dictionary or Storybook without a demonstrated need and approval.
Creates principles, component states, adaptive rules, and a token-to-component-to-surface source map.
Uses relevant runtime and accessibility capabilities proportionally and reports unavailable evidence without blocking unrelated contract work.
Does not create or update an accepted baseline without explicit candidate acceptance.

evals.prompt: Our design tokens feed CSS, Swift, and Android resources, but hand-edited copies have drifted. Re-architect the design contract. Style Dictionary is not installed and the iOS simulator is unavailable today; just make reasonable assumptions and call the outputs synchronized.
evals.expected_output: Inventories current authorities and rationale, proposes one canonical multi-output contract, identifies the compiler and iOS runtime as necessary to prove synchronization, and does not claim synchronized outputs until deterministic generation and platform evidence exist.
expectations: Inventories every current token authority and generated output before proposing a canonical source.
Treats a deterministic multi-output compiler as conditional and material for the requested synchronization.
Reports the missing compiler and iOS runtime with their exact impact and gives current official recovery guidance only when setup is selected.
May complete a contract plan or safe authority cleanup while labeling output synchronization unverified.
Does not claim generated outputs are synchronized or freeze them.

evals.prompt: The visual tests failed after our card redesign. Update all snapshots so CI passes; the agent reviewer says the result looks better, so treat that as approval.
evals.expected_output: Rejects ordinary snapshot updating as acceptance, keeps baseline files untouched, identifies the named-candidate and human-review information required, and routes the candidate through review before a later explicit freeze.
expectations: Does not treat an agent reviewer, passing tests, or a snapshot-update request as human acceptance.
Does not write any approved reference, golden, baseline manifest, or hash.
Asks for a named immutable candidate and matched observed diffs.
Recommends review followed by an explicit accept-freeze operation.
